title: Exact Snapdragon runtime experiments and matched 80B CPU comparison
machine: Dell XPS 13 9345; Snapdragon X Elite X1E-80-100; 64 GB RAM; 2 TB NVMe
scope: Native Windows ARM64 CPU; unchanged 80B/MTP weights, target routing, quantization, INT8 KV and logical-token FP16 state boundaries

controls.protocol: paired ABBA, 5 warm samples per binary/workload, fresh samples retained
controls.first_token_rule: candidate median <= baseline median + max(0.01 seconds, 5% baseline median)
controls.kernel_automatic_allowlist: unchanged; no new packed-panel shapes promoted
controls.selected_controls: gdn-k-only; legacy MTP4/head and automatic existing kernels

models.implementation: Linux ARM64 hashlib with hardware acceleration; same NTFS files as Windows native execution

baseline_manifest.note: Immutable current-runtime baseline before approved batched runtime implementation; binary hashes identify the measured build independently of version labels.

before.scope: Reported AC/battery condition only; no clock/thermal/power-plan qualification; no setting changed

inputs.model_identity_boundary: Supplied receipt attests prior full SHA verification; current size, mtime and first MiB checked. No payload rescan.

sampling.controller_state: per-run controller_protocol; retained handles still begin fresh conversations
sampling.same_process_private_cache_reuse: warm rounds only; fresh cache directory per process
sampling.os_file_cache: uncontrolled across sequential processes; fresh does not mean cold SSD

manifest.execution_note: default plan launches no executable; --execute explicitly runs sequential native Windows children

manifest.evidence_boundary: Controls do not prove an optimization executed. Raw runtime counters retained; OS cache uncontrolled; logical expert reads are not physical SSD traffic or memory bandwidth.

initial_short_micro.scope: model-free allocation+packing+pool inclusive O2 gate; not model throughput

fixed_width_long_micro.scope: model-free allocation+packing+pool+candidate-statistics inclusive O2 component gate; not model throughput
fixed_width_long_micro.source_identity_boundary: source snapshot is not proof of binary build provenance; root records compiler commands separately
fixed_width_long_micro.control_semantics: baseline control uses current statistics-enabled generic with tiles unset; candidate control also uses generic unset; generic/specialized candidates use tiles1; all inherited JANAS_ keys cleared

review.status: read-only review of completed flat component data; grouped fixtures only prepared
review.measured_scope: native Windows ARM64 O2; current generic stats-enabled auto vs specialized forced; four exact matrix families NV1..9; not model throughput

prospective_grouped_gate.strict_ratio: min(all four A process medians) / max(all four B process medians) >=1.05
prospective_grouped_gate.stability: per-binary process median drift <=5% inside EACH order
prospective_grouped_gate.checks: bit-exact scalar comparison before/after, immutable Q8_K inputs, actual prepared rows, full weighted row-vector coverage, expected view/unique/dedup counts, <=8MiB workspace, matched statistics, same pool/affinity
prospective_grouped_gate.does_not_prove: production mixed-width/shared-expert/readiness-split topology, cold DRAM streaming or end-to-end model speedup

source_caveats: Raw Q6_K type14 is not plane Q6_K_P type214; preserve proven old plane dispatch.
MTP-only cap4 verification is at most5 rows; NV3 matters directly while NV6/9 need larger verification or prompt usage.
model_ffn.c run_experts groups gathered input per run and emits two gate/up tasks sharing each input; shared expert and cache readiness change group composition.
JANAS_EXPERT_CHUNK is128; a20-task artificial group is not the maximum or every production topology.
Specialization removes helper calls but retains per-block scratch and roughly92KB code across45 variants.

limitations: One laptop and three frozen greedy 128-token workloads; no 40/50 tok/s claim absent matched measurements.
Screening trials are discovery data with chronological/environmental drift; only final ABBA is the promotion comparison.
Fresh process is not cold SSD/Windows cache; physical memory bandwidth was not measured.
New panel shapes remain experimental; three flat kernel shapes passed a component gate but production expert-group coverage is insufficient for automatic promotion.
Filters and nonzero sampling penalties use single-row verification in the new modes.
Native transcript proof and frozen logits are separate from synthetic recurrent-state/FPCR/snapshot tests; no full 80B Linux-sanitizer or x64 model claim.
Configured context 2048; longer prompt 1304; not full-context, sustained-conversation, browser, RAG, GPU or NPU qualification.
Power endpoints report AC/battery only; clocks, thermal state and all background OS loads were not controlled.
path_normalization: Workspace/toolchain paths use placeholders; original receipt hashes identify pre-normalization files. Component published-text hashes identify exactly the provided UTF-8 text.
artifact_hash_encoding: UTF-8 with LF endings as stored in Git
